traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description:
The druid is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): druidcraft, produce flame, shillelagh
- 1st level (4 slots): entangle, longstrider, speak with animals, thunderwave
- 2nd level (3 slots): animal messenger, barkskin
(spellcasting.spells lists only the pack-present spells: produce flame, shillelagh, entangle, thunderwave, barkskin. druidcraft, longstrider, speak with animals, and animal messenger are not in srd51.core/spells and are omitted; no descriptive spell stubs. Barkskin is not baked into AC, and shillelagh is not baked into the quarterstaff. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh. (The shillelagh line is descriptive only: the authored attacks are the printed non-shillelagh +2 / 1d6 and the two-handed +2 / 1d8. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)
